_metadata.label: CONTROLLED_SYNTHETIC_EVALUATION_DATA
_metadata.disclaimer: SYNTHETIC EVALUATION DATA ONLY. Used for algorithmic verification under controlled conditions. Does not represent production field telemetry or commercial claims.

cases.name: Catastrophic Customer Slip Hazard (Critical Safety Floor)
cases.rationale: High safety hazard with high severity guarantees P1_CRITICAL via direct safety floor.

cases.name: Severe Walk-in Cold Chain Failure (High Operational Impact)
cases.rationale: Substantial financial and inventory loss risk.

cases.name: Moderate Safety Risk (Spill with Caution Signs)
cases.rationale: Moderate safety hazard guarantees at least P2_HIGH floor (score >= 70).

cases.name: Standard Checkout Slowness During Peak
cases.rationale: Mid-tier operational friction without physical danger.

cases.name: High-Volume Low-Severity Annoyance (Volume Ceiling Test)
cases.rationale: Volume ceiling rule: Low severity (< 0.3) without safety risk MUST be capped at 55 (P3_MEDIUM).

cases.name: Minor Restroom Soap Empty (Low Priority Routine)
cases.rationale: Routine maintenance issue with no customer hazard or revenue impact.

cases.name: Unconfirmed Weak Signal (Confidence Discount Test)
cases.rationale: Low confidence (< 0.70) applies damping discount to prevent premature escalation on rumors.

cases.name: Multi-Store Chain Outage (Geographic Spread Boost)
cases.rationale: Cross-store propagation across 5 stores significantly amplifies score.
